Raitha Siri - Karnataka Farmer Income Support

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka, with support from the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare.

Benefits

  • Financial assistance of Rs. 10,000 per hectare to farmers growing millets such as ragi.
  • The amount is paid directly into the farmer's bank account in two instalments.

Eligibility

  • The applicant must be a farmer resident in Karnataka.
  • The farmer must cultivate ragi or other millets on at least 0.5 hectare of land.
  • Small and marginal farmers holding up to 2 hectares of land are eligible.

Exclusions

  • Farmers who are income tax payees are not eligible.
  • Institutional landholders are excluded from the scheme.

Documents Required

  • Aadhaar card
  • Land records (RTC / Pahani)
  • Bank passbook
  • Sowing certificate

How to Apply

  1. Visit the nearest Raitha Samparka Kendra with the documents listed above.
  2. Fill in the application form and submit it to the Agriculture Officer.
  3. Applications can also be submitted online through the FRUITS portal.

Important Dates

Last date to apply for the Kharif season: 31-12-2026.

Applications are open for the current season.
